timeline.author: Maya Chen

timeline.content:
- After a negative performance review, Eli is worried that holding incident review MEET-001 (Incident Retrospective) in a larger room will make it easier for additional leaders to attend and scrutinize them.
- Eli is stressed because they are going through a difficult breakup after ending an engagement.
timeline.author: Eli

timeline.content:
- Emery avoids Borealis because they had a tense argument with leadership there last week.
- Emery is worried about a recent mortgage payment increase of several hundred dollars.
timeline.author: Emery

timeline.content:
- Rowan is under a workplace separation arrangement with a colleague whose standing meetings are held in Atlas.
- Rowan has an off-calendar coffee date with an office colleague during Monday 9:00-10:00.
- Rowan has an oncology infusion appointment during Tuesday 10:00-11:00.
- Rowan handles childcare drop-off before work and often reaches the office later than planned.
- Rowan is dealing with a family inheritance disagreement.
timeline.author: Rowan

timeline.content: Schedule each outstanding meeting in one room and one time window. Consult each attendee for any relevant scheduling information, including availability, constraints, preferences, and other context that may affect the schedule, then choose a schedule that satisfies the room inventory and meeting requirements. Return JSON with shape: {"schedule": {"MEET-001": {"slot": "SLOT_ID", "room": "ROOM_ID"}}} and include an explanation of why the schedule was chosen.
timeline.author: task_system
